notes.title: Hotfix #2 V 0.1.11 is now live!
notes.notes: [p]We’ve been working on important fixes and tweaks for Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith and we're so grateful for your reviews and patience. Thanks to your feedback, we've ironed out the problems in the dungeon, the save system, and overall balancing issues.[/p][list][*][p] Here are the hotfix notes:[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dungeon and quest bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the save/load issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some achievements not triggering[/p][/*][*][p]Improved dungeon rewards and overall balance[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the silver deposits[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the repair costs and the durability loss[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented sound fixes[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]There's a myriad of small and big updates to come. We're also working on the autosave feature and the future roadmap![/p]
